review_description: One of the main reasons that we chose this company was that they replied to your request in a few days.  They were the only one  -  one other did ring well over a week later!  When we found another local quote it was much higher.  All of the personnel were excellent.
To begin with, it was very good but as time went on and when we're trying to find out the installation date it keeps getting put back.

We did not get the inverter we originally settled on. In "short" supply was the reason and we were supposedly upgraded to a better unit at no cost. Only time will tell.Installers tardy. Installation took 4 days. Didn't turn up on first day. Installer was by himself and I had to help with a drill and help lift the panels to the roof. Electrician was to follow about 1 1/2 hrs later but again it was the next day. Didn't have part of the gear and had to call 2 days later when his gas bottle ran out and he couldn't complete part of the installation. Still waiting for this to be finished. System appears to be working OK.
